finding.exposure: The public route returned raw registry rows, revealing loader and registration metadata, including arbitrary operator-provided text.

verifies: anonymous access retains the reviewed public contract
loader paths, class names, author, description, and creation timestamp are absent
requested limit and offset are forwarded to the bounded registry query
page metadata reports whether more catalog entries exist
a request over the maximum page size is rejected before the registry query
an over-limit query result returns no more than the requested page size
invalid direct registry bounds are rejected

limits: This keeps a paginated public catalog of enabled driver identities, not a public registry administration API.
This source check does not prove production ingress exposure or third-party package isolation.
